The amount written in ‘Adjustment for decrease (increase) in trade receivables, current’ includes trade and other receivables and represents both current as well non-current part.
The amount written in ‘Adjustment for decrease (increase) in trade payables, current’ includes trade and other payables and represents both current as well non-current part.
